This article is the repository-level analysis index. `manuscript.py` manages
the root Quarto Manuscript: `_quarto.yml` holds the shared HTML presentation,
and `_cse-manuscript.json` holds the ordered list of published pages. Each
analysis keeps its scientific metadata in its own `analysis.yaml`.

The [MEA parameter bundle](mea_parameter_bundle/notebook.qmd) is the main
parameter-development result. Its overview is the parent page for the
formulation, coupled-assessment, and historical-background reports listed below.
The other published pages are reference and decision evidence that support
selecting and assessing the bundle.

## Folder roles for parameter development

The physical folders stay with the result or source owner that created them.
The table below groups them by the role each record plays in reaching an
accepted parameter suite:

| Role | Folders and purpose |
|:--|:--|
| Parameter bundle | `mea_parameter_bundle/` — current candidate display, formulation studies, coupled assessment, and historical bundle background. This is the only active parameter-development parent. |
| Reference and comparison | `six_species_solubility_reference/`, `neutral_pcsaft_pressure_reference/`, `ideal_reaction_equilibrium/`, and `paper_validation/2015_baygi/` — source-aligned baselines and parity checks used to define or assess candidates. |
| Historical and decision evidence | `historical_fixed_parameter_epcsaft_evaluation/`, `reactive_epcsaft_parameter_evidence/`, and `enrtl_six_species_ideal_comparison/` — completed configurations, packet-specific comparisons, and supported-negative gates. |
| Source and input-qualification records | `film_chemistry_work_package_a/` and `speciation_evidence_harmonization/` — qualified inputs and harmonization work that feed later studies but are not parameter authorities. |
| Retired exploration | `toybox/ionic_parameter_fit_playground/` — retained rejection record only; retain for traceability and exclude from promotion. |

The remaining records are source-qualification, reference, or audit analyses without
a hosted report. Their `README.md` and `analysis.yaml` files remain the source
records. Six-species, neutral-pressure, Baygi, speciation-harmonization, film,
and toybox records stay source-only; their values are linked from the pages that
use them rather than copied into new reports.

## Publication rules

- Render `analyses/_site/` with `bash render.sh` from `analyses/`; it validates
  the manuscript and always passes `--no-execute`.
- Register a new report with `python3 manuscript.py include . <report.qmd>
  --title <title>`; an unregistered `.qmd` is not rendered.
- Keep evidence, scripts, and results in the analysis directory that owns them.
- Use page front matter only for content-specific metadata; shared presentation
  belongs in `_quarto.yml`.
- Keep `site.css` limited to the parameter-table and evidence-color rules.
- Keep execution disabled for documentation builds. Numerical refreshes remain
  separate analysis commands with their own retained records and claim limits.
